title: Case Alpha Digital Forensics #1
text: Case Alpha identifies Alex Morgan as a primary suspect. Alex Morgan used the iPhone 14 during the relevant window. The iPhone 14 contained Signal and Telegram artifacts, including logins for account alpha.

title: Case Alpha Digital Forensics #2
text: Case Alpha also lists Riley Stone as an associate. Riley Stone used the Samsung Galaxy S21. The Samsung Galaxy S21 contained WhatsApp messages that referenced Conversation Thread 17.

title: Case Alpha Digital Forensics #3
text: Persona A controlled the Signal account used in Conversation Thread 17. Alex Morgan participated in Conversation Thread 17 and Riley Stone participated in Conversation Thread 17. Conversation Thread 17 mentioned Harbor Cafe, and the Blue Sedan was observed at Harbor Cafe. Cloud Backup contained Telegram exports from the same period.
